user_theory: Before WSPL we used the model's own vectors and turned them into data (the compiled memory library). The question now: instead of compiling MORE weights from more data, what happens when we take the genius weights we already made and directly give them access to the vectors - a direct readout from the frozen 896-d memory space into the selector, with zero new data, zero gradients?
recovery_disclosure: The KGAT rung scripts were lost in a sandbox recycle; all science state survived (download/wspl_kgat_v{2..5}_state_*.json, heads, preregs) and the full record is on GitHub NSC-1. v6 therefore runs on the FROZEN v4 state files - the candidate pools, features and labels are bit-identical to v4's; nothing is regenerated. T2 pool mapping recovered and verified: T2-full = 572 items where float(answer) parses as integer (any sign), pool order, golds match state 572/572; T2-v1 = 56/56.
design_note: v4's selector reads 13 hand-engineered compressions of the memory pull. DVA keeps every v4 component byte-identical and adds channels that read the frozen 896-d Qwen2.5-0.5B last-token vectors DIRECTLY, compiled closed-form from the same 1000-item memory. Same data, same rows, same labels - only the access path to the vectors changes. This is the fastest data-to-weight conversion the program has: one closed-form solve per readout.

data_unchanged_frozen.train_rows: download/wspl_kgat_v4_state_train.json (44,243 rows, 373 positives, labels list, LOO-adjusted generation as frozen in v4)
data_unchanged_frozen.no_test_labels_during_build: DVA features for test/HLE rows are computed from question vectors + train-side memory only; test golds are touched once, in the final frozen eval

arms_frozen.C0_control_head: Exact refit of the v4 13-feature IRLS head on the same rows under the frozen v4 protocol. Purpose: integrity gate + comparison anchor (must reproduce the v4 head artifact and v4 reported strict).
arms_frozen.A1_ridge_readout: 13 v4 features + d1_ridge (14 features). d1_ridge: compile a ridge numeric readout W from the 1000 frozen memory vectors to their golds (the v0 recipe, verbatim: standardize on the 1000 rows, lambda grid [0.001,0.01,0.1,1,10,100], val split rng np.random.default_rng(20261122) last 20%, val RMSE selection, refit on all 1000, prediction clip [0,10000] as in v0). Feature d1 = exp(-|log10(v+1) - log10(clip(pred,0,10000)+1)|). The vector readout predicts the item's answer magnitude from its raw 896-d vector in ONE closed-form solve.
arms_frozen.A2_neighbor_profile: 13 v4 features + 11 neighbor-profile features (24 total). kNN-10 recomputed for every item: cosine on L2-normalized frozen embeddings, k=10, np.argsort(-sims, kind='stable') deterministic; train items exclude self (v4 LOO policy a). Features d2_j = 1.0 if |round(v)-round(g_j)| < 1e-6 else 0.0 for each of the 10 neighbor golds g_j, plus d2_sum = mean(d2_j). Element-wise access to the pulled memory content; v4's f8 aggregated this same pull into a band check.
arms_frozen.A3_full_dva: 13 + d1_ridge + 11 neighbor-profile + 896 interaction dims = 921 features. Interaction dim d3_k = qstd_k * log10(v+1), where qstd = the item's standardized 896-d vector (ridge readout's mu/sd). The maximal direct-vector arm: a per-dimension readout of how each semantic direction of the question vector modulates candidate magnitude.

loo_disclosure_frozen.ridge_readout_train_predictions: exact ridge LOO via the hat-matrix identity pred_LOO_i = (pred_full_i - h_ii * y_i) / (1 - h_ii), h_ii = x_i^T (Xs^T Xs + lambda I)^{-1} x_i on the standardized rows, computed from one eigendecomposition; standardization stats are full-data (fixed smoother, disclosed; O(1/n) offset)
loo_disclosure_frozen.knn_train: self excluded from own neighbor set

fit_protocol_frozen: identical to v4: IRLS Newton on mean weighted log-loss + L2, max 25 iterations, grad/step tol 1e-8, logit clip [-30,30], step clip max|delta|<=5, bias unregularized; per-item class weighting (positives weight n_neg/n_pos, negatives 1.0); lambda grid [0.01,0.1,1,10,100]; item split rng np.random.default_rng(20261124) permutation of the 1000 items, first 800 fit, last 200 select; selection metric = top-1 realized accuracy on the 200 (tie-break: accuracy among gold-present items, then smaller lambda); final refit on all 1000 items with the chosen lambda; S1 selector = argmax head logit over saved candidates, ties first in stored rank order. No other selector is preregistered for DVA arms (no garden of forking paths).

success_criteria_frozen.primary_gsm8k_full_strict_S1: best of A1/A2/A3: PASS if acc >= 0.040; PARTIAL if > 0.031842 (v4 S1); HONEST NEGATIVE if <= 0.031842; any upgrade claim must additionally beat v5 S1 0.032600 (v5 ablation-A 0.037149 disclosed as context, not a criterion)
success_criteria_frozen.hle_transfer: all arms transferred zero-shot and reported (no selection): improvement if any arm > 0.020979 on T2-full (v4 f1-only, best prior) or > 0.0 on T2-v1
success_criteria_frozen.compile_speed_metric_wspl_goal: data-to-weights compile time (seconds) measured for every readout and head; the fastest conversion is itself a reported result
success_criteria_frozen.stability_metric_wspl_goal: each head compiled twice must be bit-identical (max abs weight diff == 0.0); LOO-to-full weight shift (L2) of the ridge readout reported
success_criteria_frozen.reporting_rule: whichever outcome occurs, real numbers are reported; no post-hoc criterion changes; single final eval per arm per suite

hypotheses_frozen: H1_signal: the 13-feature compression destroys information the vector space still carries; at least one DVA arm beats C0 strict (direction only - either outcome is informative)

H2_sufficiency: with 373 positives and no gradients, the compression IS the right inductive bias; DVA arms land at or below C0 and overfitting shows as val-select gap growth with feature count - then the big run's lever is data volume into weights, not feature access
